interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked midblock crossings with high-visibility continental markings and appropriate warning signage.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Plant trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic and encourage slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure the pedestrian clear zone is maintained by preventing vehicles from encroaching on the walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone to ensure a continuous, unobstructed clear path for pedestrians and wheelchair users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone with street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Convert the existing marked bike lane into a protected facility using bollards or a raised median to further separate vulnerable road users from motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised medians at crossing points to reduce the exposure time of pedestrians to traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number of curb cuts to minimize the number of conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and create a dedicated zone for utility poles to ensure a continuous, unobstructed pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Clearance
interventions.description: Expand the pedestrian walkway to meet ADA standards and enforce parking regulations to ensure a clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking near building entrances and potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees and a furniture zone to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a marked midblock crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe point for pedestrians to cross this long block.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island at the mid-block crossing to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to the crossing to increase driver awareness and yielding rates.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation or Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the car wash entrance to minimize the conflict area and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or lane widths to reclaim space for a protected bike lane and wider pedestrian buffers.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and RRFB (Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon).

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a central pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add street trees and a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve pedestrian comfort and provide a physical barrier from traffic.

interventions.title: Construct Continuous Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Install Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Build out the curb at the mid-block crossing to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Crossing Signage and Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crossing signs and improved overhead lighting specifically for the mid-block crossing.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install a continuous planting zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Streetscape Improvements
interventions.description: Add street trees and lighting to the sidewalk to improve the pedestrian experience and provide a physical buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the commercial driveway to the minimum necessary for truck access to shorten pedestrian exposure.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk Crossing
interventions.description: Continue the sidewalk at grade across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Parking Restrictions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Implement and enforce 'No Parking' zones near the driveway to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with RRFB
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk equipped with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to crossing pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a raised, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide a safe and separated space for pedestrians.
